title: Master of Dumplings (1428)
problem: The skin → Ultimate switch covers code skins 129-132, 134-150 and 572-580. 133 = Dreamsicle (skins.json 134) is missing, so it falls to the random pick.
notes: In-game test: Equip the Dreamsicle skin on a Master of Dumplings creature; its Ultimate spell is the Dumplings one (442), never a random one. Community claim: The Dreamsicle skin has no Ultimate and gives a random one. Evidence: bc_StartupGems: skin @0x141706b03; case values @0x141706b6f-0x141706e7e (0x81-0x84, 0x86-0x96, 0x23c-0x244; no 0x85). Fix sketch: Add a case for 133 with Caliban's Avatar Ultimate (H). Triage 2026-10-26: Skin switch has no case for code skin 133 (Dreamsicle). Hook: add the case with Caliban's Avatar Ultimate.

release_notes.intended: Your Dumplings gain an Ultimate based on the wild Dumpling skin they wear.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the Dreamsicle skin had no matching Ultimate and got a random one.
release_notes.fix: Now the Dreamsicle skin gives Caliban's Ultimate, Awakened Nether Orbs.
